name: visual
summary: Render v1 reference compositions through the real v2 Stage (Pixi) and pixel-diff against v1 screenshots (region of blocks/overlays/lines); `bakeoff` scores the three block renderers (baked/msaa/ss2) on parity and frame time (UI-0005).
usage: pnpm bd visual diff --renderer msaa --only proximity-chain --save-all
outputs: JSON summary; tests/visual/output/v2-diff/*.png for failures; docs/engineering/renderer-bakeoff.md (bakeoff)
